companyDescription: Quantum computing · Novera QPU hardware + Cepheus-1 108-qubit systems — $100M Dept. of Commerce LOI, NSF-funded Pittsburgh Supercomputing testbed, riding a sector-wide rally on reports the U.S. government may take equity stakes in quantum computing firms
priceNote: Live $11.31 (-1.8%) on Oct 26, 2026 — at the 52-week low ($11.11-$44.52), -35% since Aug 10. Market cap ~$3.77B.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Aug 10, 2026). The $100M Dept. of Commerce LOI converted into a definitive agreement, but RGTI still fell ~35% to its 52-week low as quantum names de-rated around IonQ's $2B raise. Q3 earnings on Nov 9 are the next dated catalyst. Consensus $28.53 (+152%; clears the gate). Catalyst type moved from partnership_win (the tier-2 laggard; now realized) to earnings_beat. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +25% assumes a 1-3 month relief rally if Q3 shows roadmap progress. The Nov 9 print is 14 days out, at the edge of the North Star window. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: $100M Dept. of Commerce definitive agreement — signed
catalysts.description: The LOI converted into a definitive agreement to accelerate superconducting quantum R&D (alongside DoC investments in D-Wave and Quantinuum).

risks: Revenue is tiny (TTM $13.4M) against a ~$239M TTM net loss — the valuation is entirely roadmap.
Quantum sentiment is fragile: peers' dilution (IonQ $2B) drags the group.
Technical roadmap execution (fidelity, qubit scaling) vs. trapped-ion and neutral-atom competitors.
Government funding concentration — DoC money also went to D-Wave and Quantinuum.
High beta to rates and retail flows.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Well-funded but pre-scale quantum hardware; trades as a high-beta rate/sentiment proxy with IONQ and QBTS.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.
